meta.title: የሚጠብቅ ጎረቤት
meta.tts_style_instruction: Warm, unhurried Ethiopian storytelling. A calm adult remembering childhood with tenderness and seriousness. Clear Amharic, steady pace, no laughter, and no promotional tone.

style_block.look: Cinematic and realistic. Warm golden-hour light outdoors and warm indoor electric light. An everyday urban Ethiopian residential neighbourhood: painted plaster and concrete compound walls, a metal compound gate, a paved or cobblestone lane, and a cozy living room with ordinary furniture.
style_block.framing: The person who matters is centered, with room above and below, so the still can be cropped to 9:16 or 16:9.
style_block.camera: Subtle documentary movement. No fast cuts and no dramatic crane moves.
style_block.safety: Smoking is awkward and unpleasant. The child coughs. The image is never instructional or glamorous.

shots.reason: Open on the urban home the memory belongs to, before any person has to carry the story.
shots.narration_am: ከታናሽ ወንድሜ ጋር የተያያዘ፣ ፈጽሞ ልረሳው የማልችለው አንድ የልጅነት ትዝታ አለኝ።
shots.subtitle_en: There is one childhood memory, tied to my younger brother, that I will never be able to forget.

shots.subtitle_en: When we were children, our mother sold traditional drinks from our home. People came again and again to buy a drink and to talk.

shots.reason: Introduce the regular customer who smoked while he drank, without making the habit look appealing.
shots.narration_am: ከደንበኞቻችን መካከል ሁልጊዜ ከመጠጥ ጋር ሲጋራ የሚያጨስ አንድ ሰው ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: Among our customers was a man who always smoked a cigarette with his drink.

An Ethiopian man in his 40s, in a casual jacket and a collared shirt, sits on a plain chair just outside a metal compound gate. An unmarked glass is beside him. He holds a cigarette and a thin, unattractive wisp of smoke rises. He is not posed, not stylish, and not glamorous. The smoking looks like a tired habit. In the doorway behind him, slightly soft, a primary-school-age Ethiopian boy in a faded mustard t-shirt, cuffed jeans, and worn sneakers watches. Late-afternoon light on a paved residential lane, painted concrete wall. Fictional people. Centered framing with room above and below for 9:16 and 16:9 crops. No text, no logo, no flame close-up, no watermark.
shots.motion_prompt: Smoke drifts and thins. The man does not perform for the camera. The boy remains still in the doorway.

shots.reason: Show the brother's curiosity about the customer's posture, before he has touched anything.
shots.narration_am: ታናሽ ወንድሜም የሰውየውን አቋቋም እና ማጨስ በጉጉት እያየ፣ ጉዳቱን ሳይረዳ መሞከር ፈለገ።
shots.subtitle_en: My younger brother watched the man's posture and his smoking with curiosity and, without understanding the harm, wanted to try it.

His face is curious and uncertain, not delighted. He looks toward an out-of-focus Ethiopian man in a casual jacket and collared shirt, seated farther back with a cigarette and an unmarked glass. Centered, with space above and below for a 9:16 or 16:9 crop. No text, no logo, no watermark. The boy is not holding a cigarette.

shots.reason: The boy finds a discarded cigarette on the ground at sunset.
shots.narration_am: አንድ ምሽት ፀሐይ እየጠለቀች ሳለ፣ ወንድሜ መሬት ላይ የተጣለች ትንሽ ሲጋራ አየ።
shots.subtitle_en: One evening, as the sun was setting, my brother saw a small cigarette that had been thrown on the ground.

It looks like rubbish, not a product. At the edge of the center, the worn sneakers and lowered hand of a primary-school-age Ethiopian boy in cuffed jeans. He has just noticed it. shots.reason: He checks that nobody is watching and hurries toward the compound wall.
shots.narration_am: ማንም እንዳላየው አረጋግጦ፣ ጨለማው የሚደብቀው መስሎት ወደ አጥሩ ፈጥኖ ሄደ።
shots.subtitle_en: After making sure that nobody saw him, and thinking the darkness would hide him, he hurried to the fence.

shots.reason: He tries to copy the customer's stance and immediately starts coughing. The attempt fails.
shots.narration_am: አንድ እግሩን ግድግዳው ጋር ለጥፎ ሰውየውን ለመምሰል ሲሞክር ግን፣ ወዲያው ማሳል ጀመረ።
shots.subtitle_en: He pressed one foot against the wall to imitate the man, but he immediately started coughing.

He is coughing hard, eyes watering, shoulders hunched, face turned slightly aside. He looks uncomfortable and embarrassed, not cool and not pleased. shots.reason: The older married neighbours notice him and stop him.
shots.narration_am: ልክ በዚያች ቅጽበት፣ በአቅራቢያው ያልፉ የነበሩ በእድሜ የገፉ የምናውቃቸው ጎረቤት ባልና ሚስት አዩትና አስቆሙት።
shots.subtitle_en: At that very moment, an older married couple, neighbours the family knew, were passing nearby. They saw him and stopped him.
shots.image_prompt: Photorealistic cinematic medium shot at dusk, subject centered. An Ethiopian woman in her 60s, in a neat coat with a light gabi over her shoulders, and an Ethiopian man in his 60s, in a neat sweater, have stopped on a cobblestone residential lane. Their faces show concern, not anger. The woman holds a gentle open hand toward a primary-school-age boy in a faded mustard t-shirt, cuffed jeans, and worn sneakers, who is still coughing beside a painted plaster wall. No one is shouting. No cigarette is celebrated. Warm dim street light, metal compound gates along the lane. Fictional people, centered with room above and below for 9:16 and 16:9 crops. No text, no logo, no watermark.
shots.motion_prompt: The couple stop walking. The woman extends a careful hand. The boy coughs once more and looks down.

shots.reason: They bring him home and tell his mother, who is saddened and explains the harm.
shots.narration_am: ችላ ብለው ከማለፍ ይልቅ ወደ ቤት ይዘውት ገብተው ለእናታችን ነገሯት። እሷም በጣም አዝና፣ ሲጋራ ምን ያህል ጎጂ እንደሆነ አስረዳችው።
shots.subtitle_en: Instead of ignoring it and walking past, they brought him into the house and told our mother. She was deeply saddened, and she explained how harmful cigarettes are.

An Ethiopian woman in her late 30s, in a casual dress and light cardigan, kneels to meet a primary-school-age boy in a faded mustard t-shirt and cuffed jeans. Her face is sad and caring, not theatrical. Behind them, an older woman in a coat with a light gabi and an older man in a sweater stand quietly, having brought the boy home. The conversation is serious. Mouths are not shaped around readable words. No cigarette is shown as desirable. Fictional people, centered with space above and below for 9:16 and 16:9 crops. shots.reason: Close on the outcome: he never tried again, and the community shares the duty to protect a child.
shots.narration_am: ከዚያ ቀን ጀምሮ ዳግመኛ ሲጋራ አልነካም። ልጅን መጠበቅ የወላጅ ብቻ ሳይሆን የማህበረሰብ ኃላፊነት ነው።
shots.subtitle_en:
From that day on, he never touched a cigarette again. Protecting a child is not only a parent's responsibility. It is the responsibility of the community.

Before it burns, while it is still a leaf.
shots.proverb_en: Before it burns, while it is still a leaf.
